items.name: Fraud score calculation accuracy
items.description: Verify fraud scoring engine produces accurate scores for known fraud and legitimate transaction patterns using the v2 XGBoost model. Score accuracy validated against labeled test dataset with AUC-ROC > 0.96.

test_steps.description: Load labeled test dataset with 10,000 transactions (50% fraud, 50% legitimate)
test_steps.expected_result: Dataset loaded successfully

test_steps.description: Run feature extraction pipeline on test transactions
test_steps.expected_result: All 47 features computed for each transaction

test_steps.description: Score all transactions using fraud model v2
test_steps.expected_result: Scores returned within 50ms p99 latency SLA

test_steps.description: Calculate AUC-ROC on scored results
test_steps.expected_result: AUC-ROC >= 0.96

test_steps.description: Calculate false positive rate at 0.5 threshold
test_steps.expected_result: False positive rate < 2%

test_steps.description: Verify score distribution matches training baseline
test_steps.expected_result: KS statistic < 0.05 between training and test distributions

test_steps.description: Validate model metadata in mfs_fraud_db.model_registry
test_steps.expected_result: Model v2 entry present with correct metrics

test_steps.description: Verify scoring results written to mfs_fraud_db.fraud_scores
test_steps.expected_result: All 10,000 scores persisted with correct transaction IDs

items.name: Feature extraction pipeline latency
items.description: Verify real-time feature extraction service computes all fraud-relevant features within latency budget. Tests Kafka consumer throughput and feature computation performance.

test_steps.description: Publish 1,000 raw transactions to mfs.txn.raw Kafka topic
test_steps.expected_result: All messages published successfully

test_steps.description: Monitor feature extraction consumer processing
test_steps.expected_result: Consumer processes all 1,000 messages without errors

test_steps.description: Verify enriched events on mfs.txn.features topic
test_steps.expected_result: 1,000 enriched events with all 47 features present

test_steps.description: Measure end-to-end latency (publish to enriched event)
test_steps.expected_result: p95 latency < 20ms, p99 < 35ms

test_steps.description: Verify merchant_risk_score computation against reference table
test_steps.expected_result: Scores match expected values from mfs_fraud_db.merchant_risk

test_steps.description: Test consumer recovery after simulated Kafka broker failure
test_steps.expected_result: Consumer reconnects and resumes processing within 30 seconds

items.name: Model A/B test routing
items.description: Verify model versioning framework correctly routes traffic between model versions according to configured split percentages and collects per-variant performance metrics.

test_steps.description: Configure A/B test with 80/20 split between model v1 and v2
test_steps.expected_result: Configuration applied successfully via svc-model-serving

test_steps.description: Send 10,000 scoring requests through the model router
test_steps.expected_result: All requests scored without errors

test_steps.description: Verify traffic distribution matches configured split
test_steps.expected_result: 80% (+/- 2%) routed to v1, 20% (+/- 2%) routed to v2

test_steps.description: Check per-variant metrics collection in mfs_fraud_db.ab_test_results
test_steps.expected_result: Separate AUC-ROC and FP rate recorded for each variant

test_steps.description: Simulate v2 underperformance (FP rate > baseline + 0.5%)
test_steps.expected_result: Automated rollback triggered within 5 minutes

test_steps.description: Verify rollback routes 100% traffic to v1
test_steps.expected_result: All subsequent requests served by v1

test_steps.description: Verify rollback event logged to model registry
test_steps.expected_result: Rollback reason and timestamp recorded in mfs_fraud_db.model_versions

items.name: Transaction velocity threshold detection
items.description: Verify transaction velocity monitor correctly detects and alerts on threshold breaches across per-account, per-merchant, and per-device dimensions over sliding time windows.

test_steps.description: Configure velocity thresholds: 5 txns/1min, 20 txns/5min per account
test_steps.expected_result: Rules loaded via hot-reload without restart

test_steps.description: Simulate 6 transactions from same account within 1 minute
test_steps.expected_result: Velocity alert generated on mfs.alerts.txn topic

test_steps.description: Verify alert contains correct metadata (account, dimension, window, count)
test_steps.expected_result: Alert payload matches expected schema

test_steps.description: Test per-merchant velocity: 50 inbound txns to same merchant in 5 minutes
test_steps.expected_result: Merchant velocity alert generated

test_steps.description: Verify alerts persisted to mfs_fraud_db.alerts table
test_steps.expected_result: Both alerts stored with correct timestamps and severity

items.name: Anomaly detection alert generation
items.description: Verify anomaly detection system identifies unusual transaction patterns and generates alerts with correct severity classification.

test_steps.description: Inject known anomalous transaction pattern (amount 10x average, new device, foreign IP)
test_steps.expected_result: Anomaly detected by both Z-score and isolation forest models

test_steps.description: Verify anomaly score > 0.9 for HIGH severity classification
test_steps.expected_result: Alert classified as HIGH severity

test_steps.description: Inject borderline anomaly (amount 3x average, known device)
test_steps.expected_result: Score between 0.7-0.9, classified as MEDIUM

test_steps.description: Verify alert routing: HIGH to immediate queue, MEDIUM to batch queue
test_steps.expected_result: Alerts routed to correct queues

test_steps.description: Test escalation: no acknowledgment after 15 minutes
test_steps.expected_result: Escalation triggered to senior analyst queue

test_steps.description: Verify all alerts published to mfs.alerts.txn Kafka topic
test_steps.expected_result: Alert events contain correct schema and correlation IDs

items.name: AML rule engine pattern matching
items.description: Verify AML rule engine correctly identifies structuring, layering, and integration money laundering patterns from transaction data in mfs_aml_db.

test_steps.description: Seed mfs_aml_db with structuring test data: 5 deposits of $9,500 from same customer in 3 days
test_steps.expected_result: Test data inserted into aml_transactions table

test_steps.description: Run structuring detection rule AML-STRUCT-001
test_steps.expected_result: Pattern detected with confidence > 0.85

test_steps.description: Seed layering test data: funds moved through 4 accounts within 24 hours
test_steps.expected_result: Test data inserted with correct account linkages

test_steps.description: Run layering detection rule AML-LAYER-001
test_steps.expected_result: Layering pattern detected with all intermediate accounts identified

test_steps.description: Seed integration test data: large cash deposit split into legitimate-appearing purchases
test_steps.expected_result: Test data reflects integration pattern

test_steps.description: Run integration detection rule AML-INTEG-001
test_steps.expected_result: Integration pattern detected

test_steps.description: Verify all detected patterns create AML case records in mfs_aml_db.cases
test_steps.expected_result: 3 case records created with correct rule IDs and evidence links

test_steps.description: Validate detection results against known-good baseline
test_steps.expected_result: Zero false negatives on seeded patterns

test_steps.description: Run rules against clean transaction data (no AML patterns)
test_steps.expected_result: Zero false positives generated

items.name: SAR auto-generation and filing
items.description: Verify automated SAR form pre-population from AML case data and CTR filing integration with FinCEN BSA E-Filing system.

test_steps.description: Create AML case with structuring detection from TC-FRD-006
test_steps.expected_result: Case record created in mfs_aml_db.cases

test_steps.description: Trigger SAR auto-generation for the case
test_steps.expected_result: SAR form pre-populated with subject info, transaction details, and narrative

test_steps.description: Validate SAR XML against FinCEN schema
test_steps.expected_result: XML passes FinCEN validation with no errors

test_steps.description: Submit SAR to FinCEN BSA E-Filing sandbox
test_steps.expected_result: Filing accepted with confirmation number

test_steps.description: Trigger CTR auto-filing for >$10,000 transaction
test_steps.expected_result: CTR form generated with correct aggregation of same-day transactions

test_steps.description: Verify filing records stored in mfs_aml_db.filings
test_steps.expected_result: SAR and CTR filing records with confirmation numbers and timestamps

test_steps.description: Test batch submission with 5 SARs
test_steps.expected_result: Batch accepted, all 5 filings confirmed

items.name: OCR extraction accuracy for passport documents
items.description: Verify Tesseract OCR pipeline accurately extracts identity fields from passport documents including MRZ parsing, name extraction, date of birth, document number, and expiry date with minimum confidence threshold.

test_steps.description: Submit high-quality passport image (300 DPI, well-lit, no glare) to OCR pipeline
test_steps.expected_result: All identity fields extracted with confidence >= 0.95

test_steps.description: Validate MRZ line parsing against known passport MRZ checksums
test_steps.expected_result: MRZ checksum validation passes for all check digits

test_steps.description: Submit degraded passport image (low contrast, slight rotation) to OCR pipeline
test_steps.expected_result: Fields extracted with confidence >= 0.85 after pre-processing (deskew, contrast normalization)

test_steps.description: Verify extracted fields persisted to mfs_customers_db.document_verifications with correct confidence scores
test_steps.expected_result: Document verification record created with ocr_confidence and authenticity_score populated

items.name: OCR extraction for driver's license with varied image quality
items.description: Verify OCR pipeline handles driver's license documents across varying image quality conditions including low resolution, partial occlusion, and glare.

test_steps.description: Submit standard driver's license image to OCR pipeline and validate extraction of name, DOB, license number, expiry, and address fields
test_steps.expected_result: All fields extracted with confidence >= 0.90

test_steps.description: Submit low-resolution driver's license image (150 DPI) with slight blur
test_steps.expected_result: Image quality check flags low quality; OCR attempts extraction with reduced confidence threshold (>= 0.75) or routes to manual review

test_steps.description: Submit driver's license image with glare obscuring partial text and verify graceful degradation
test_steps.expected_result: Extractable fields returned with individual confidence scores; obscured fields flagged as low-confidence and routed for manual verification

items.name: Liveness detection anti-spoofing verification
items.description: Verify AWS Rekognition-based liveness detection correctly identifies live subjects and rejects spoofing attempts including printed photos, screen replay, and 3D masks.

test_steps.description: Submit live selfie video with active challenge (head turn left, blink) from genuine user
test_steps.expected_result: Passive liveness score >= 0.95, active challenge passed, is_spoof_detected = false

test_steps.description: Submit printed photo of subject held in front of camera
test_steps.expected_result: Spoof detected: is_spoof_detected = true, passive liveness score < 0.3

test_steps.description: Submit screen replay attack (video of subject played on phone screen)
test_steps.expected_result: Spoof detected: is_spoof_detected = true, moire pattern or reflection artifacts identified

test_steps.description: Submit document photo and live selfie for face match comparison
test_steps.expected_result: Face match score >= 0.95 for genuine match; < 0.5 for mismatched identities

test_steps.description: Verify all liveness results persisted to mfs_customers_db.liveness_results with correct scores and detection flags
test_steps.expected_result: Liveness result records created with passive_liveness_score, active_challenge_passed, face_match_score, and is_spoof_detected fields

items.name: Case routing assigns correct priority based on risk score
items.description: Verify fraud case routing engine assigns correct priority level and analyst queue based on aggregate risk score from multiple detection sources.

test_steps.description: Create fraud case with risk score >= 0.9 from combined velocity and anomaly alerts
test_steps.expected_result: Case assigned priority P1 and routed to immediate investigation queue

test_steps.description: Create fraud case with risk score 0.7-0.9 from single anomaly detection source
test_steps.expected_result: Case assigned priority P2 and routed to standard investigation queue

test_steps.description: Create fraud case with risk score < 0.7 from velocity-only alert
test_steps.expected_result: Case assigned priority P3 and routed to batch review queue

items.name: Evidence aggregation from multiple detection sources
items.description: Verify fraud case evidence aggregation correctly collects, correlates, and presents evidence from velocity monitoring, anomaly detection, and AML detection sources into a unified case evidence timeline.

test_steps.description: Trigger velocity alert, anomaly detection alert, and AML pattern match for the same account within a 1-hour window
test_steps.expected_result: Three separate evidence records created in mfs_fraud_db.case_evidence with distinct source_type values

test_steps.description: Verify evidence aggregation service correlates all three sources into a single fraud case
test_steps.expected_result: Single fraud_cases record created with all three evidence records linked via case_id foreign key

test_steps.description: Retrieve aggregated evidence timeline via case API and verify chronological ordering
test_steps.expected_result: Evidence items returned in chronological order with correct source_type (velocity, anomaly, aml) and evidence_data payloads

test_steps.description: Verify aggregate risk score is computed from combined evidence sources and is higher than any individual source score
test_steps.expected_result: Case risk_score reflects weighted combination of all evidence sources and exceeds maximum individual source score
